evidence_scope: Gate A ProbeEvent feasibility harness; private ABI v1 adapter acceptance requires its own run

capture_adapter_acceptance.command: sudo -n env HOME=/home/ubuntu CARGO_HOME=/home/ubuntu/.cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/home/ubuntu/.rustup PATH=/home/ubuntu/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo test -p chronicle-capture-ebpf --test privileged_adapter -- --ignored

supported: Linux 6.8 aarch64 with cgroup v2 and BTF
plaintext client-initiated IPv4 and IPv6 TCP
veth GSO/GRO metadata and nonlinear payload visibility; separate 32 KiB aggregate via two ordered 16 KiB continuations
socket-cookie correlation across connect, sock_ops, and cgroup_skb
100 ms-or-later cumulative complete per-CPU loss sampling
unsupported: current PID/TGID from sock_ops or cgroup_skb context
current cgroup helper from cgroup_skb as socket-owner identity
reset versus orderly close from sock_ops state alone
